title: Invite gives one link that signs a person in once from any device
description: The invite check GY-3486 bound, now covering the one-link invite flow that replaced the Tailscale-login invite: it runs the same check as one-link-invite. Invite returns exactly one link on the Funnel address; opening it signs the person in once and a second open is refused; a teammate's session is short and renews with use; revoking a maintainer closes their Master page at once; and a command typed into the master session stays confined.

steps.name: One-link invite, Funnel, revoke, typed list and master confinement
